goal: Measure whether one deterministic head-only adaptation on the frozen 12000-pair TRAIN subset improves validation mAP over the frozen official S2 checkpoint.

model.adaptation: Retain and train only vision_encoder.fc; freeze the complete ResNet-50 backbone, including BatchNorm state.
model.head_initialization: Retain the official checkpoint's aligned 19-class head.
class_order: Land principally occupied by agriculture, with significant areas of natural vegetation
Natural grassland and sparsely vegetated areas

normalization_statistics: Use the frozen official-training-split profile; do not recompute.

requirements: validation macro average precision delta is greater than zero
validation macro F1 delta is at least -0.02 at the frozen 0.5 threshold
all integrity and provenance checks pass
decision_rule.note: The mAP criterion requires any positive measured improvement, not an arbitrary five-point gain; the exact delta is always retained.

resources.multi_gpu_execution: torch DataParallel when both GPUs are visible
resources.estimated_runtime: 15-35 minutes including package verification/extraction, up to 10 epochs, and final validation
resources.estimated_peak_gpu_memory: approximately 3-6 GiB per T4 at batch size 128 split across two GPUs

checkpoint_output: phase4f_s2_head.safetensors (Kaggle output only; bytes are not committed to Git)
